description: International management standards that help companies minimise the risk of accidents and their environmental impact.

blocks.text: Building a safety and environmental culture
International management standards that help companies minimise the risk of accidents and their environmental impact.

items: ISO 45001 (health and safety): The implementation of ISO 45001 improves employee safety.
System integration: These systems are often integrated to increase efficiency.

blocks.text: Objective assessment and identification of areas for improvement

Internal audits are primarily conducted to systematically assess the company’s compliance with standards, identify areas for improvement, and ensure continuous improvement in occupational safety and environmental protection.

items: Compliance assessment: To systematically assess the company’s compliance with standards.
Detecting gaps: To identify areas for improvement.
Management support: To ensure continuous improvement in occupational safety and environmental protection.
